name: Barcode Generator (Code128)
summary: Generate Code 128 barcodes as SVG from ASCII text — copy or download locally.
description: Create scannable Code 128 Set B barcodes for product SKUs, asset tags, and inventory labels. Adjust bar height and module width, preview instantly, and export SVG without sending data to a server.

faqs.question: Which characters are supported?
faqs.answer: Code 128 Set B supports printable ASCII (space through tilde).

faqs.question: What format is exported?
faqs.answer: SVG vector graphics — sharp at any size and easy to embed in print layouts.
